meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过追问打磨方案并自动生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在讨论中完善设计并同步产出文档
copy.tagline_en: Sharpen plans through relentless questioning while generating docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to refine designs through discussion and produce docs simultaneously

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以刨根问底的方式持续追问,帮你把计划或设计想清楚,过程中自动产生 ADR(架构决策记录)和术语表。
howto.when: 当你想深入打磨一个计划或设计,并需要记录决策与术语时,手动启动该技能。

say.text: 请用 grill-with-docs 对我的项目方案进行一场追问式访谈。
say.note: Claude 会连续提问,并同步生成相关文档。

say.text: 围绕这个设计开始 grilling,并把关键决策记成 ADR。
say.note: 会得到结构化记录和术语表。

say.text: 用 grill-with-docs 帮我审视这份规划,找出漏洞。
say.note: 会逐一追问细节,给出改进方向。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude conducts a relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, producing ADRs and a glossary along the way.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you manually start the skill to refine a plan or design and record decisions and terminology.

say_en.text: Run grill-with-docs to interview my project plan.
say_en.note: Claude will keep asking and create docs.

say_en.text: Start grilling on this design and log key decisions as ADRs.
say_en.note: You'll get structured records and a glossary.

say_en.text: Use grill-with-docs to review this plan and find gaps.
say_en.note: It will probe details and suggest improvements.
